svg.title: The stage rate in this formula is the positive rate of the actual already chosen post-length estimates. Choose its threshold separately for each stage and include these thresholds among the entry-delay maxima. At step m, use the outgoing stage J(m + 1), x = bβm, and y = bβm+1 ≥x. This gives the squared-reserve bound simultaneously for every m, with the same post-length data. The same delay can enforce log bβm ≥1. Startup has a corresponding reserve without requiring a preceding block. In the startup formulas write s = log x, so their large parameter is Ms = e(log s)2 = M(x) and their small remainder exponent is γs = e−Ms/2.
